description: Modern Xposed Service - Communication interface between Xposed framework and module app (IPC, Scope Management, Process Discovery, Hot Reload, RemotePreferences, and Direct Boot)

directBoot.summary: XposedProvider is Direct Boot aware. Xposed frameworks can deliver service binders before the user unlocks the device for the first time after a reboot.
guidelines: The module app's Application initialization and service listener callbacks must be safe to run before user unlock.
Use Context.createDeviceProtectedStorageContext() for local data needed before unlock.
Defer access to credential-protected storage until UserManager.isUserUnlocked() returns true.
Remote preferences and remote files availability before unlock depends on framework implementation.

methods.name: getApiVersion
methods.doc: Returns the service API version of the running framework.

methods.name: getFrameworkName
methods.doc: Returns the host framework name (e.g. LSPosed).

methods.doc: Returns the host framework version string.

methods.doc: Returns the framework version code.

methods.name: getFrameworkProperties

methods.doc: Returns the application package scope configured for this module.

methods.name: requestScope
methods.signature: void requestScope(@NonNull List<String> packages, @NonNull OnScopeEventListener callback)
methods.doc: Asynchronously requests the framework to expand module scope to include the specified packages.

methods.doc: Removes specified packages from module scope.

methods.name: getRunningTargets
methods.doc: Queries all currently running processes that are hooked by this module. Returned targets can be used to trigger hot reloading.

methods.name: hotReloadModule
methods.signature: void hotReloadModule(@NonNull HookedTarget target, @Nullable Bundle data, @NonNull HotReloadCallback callback)

methods.name: getRemotePreferences
methods.doc: Retrieves or creates a named group of RemotePreferences stored in the Xposed framework.

methods.doc: Deletes a named group of RemotePreferences.

methods.name: listRemoteFiles

methods.doc: Opens a ParcelFileDescriptor to a remote file.

methods.name: deleteRemoteFile
methods.doc: Deletes a remote file from module's shared data directory.

methods.name: onScopeRequestApproved
methods.doc: Called when user/framework approves the scope expansion.

methods.name: onScopeRequestFailed
methods.doc: Called when scope request is rejected or fails.

methods.name: onHotReloadResult
